source.notes: Source labels, taxonomy, numeric identifiers, UUIDs, hierarchy, and order are preserved from the Lucid payload without nomenclatural modernisation. Synthetic IDs are one-based, zero-padded identifiers assigned deterministically from source order within each record class. The year is the citation year stated by the archived About page; associated fact sheets carry 2025 copyright notices. Scoring vectors and dependencies are intentionally excluded from this ontology file.
